results.title: A token dated after the moment it was requested
results.evidence: an authority returned a token dated a year ahead of the request and it was stored and read back with state 'unverified' and no remark. `stamp` records `requested_at` alongside the token and the module says exactly why — *the gap between them is the only thing a reader can use to notice a token that was issued somewhere else* — and nothing computes that gap.
